question: Should the shared OpenClawKit recovery contract support independently retried producers, or should retry policy force both producer scans to rerun together before intersection?
rationale: The PR deliberately introduces failed-jobs-only retries, but the current artifact naming/consumption contract is attempt-wide; choosing the intended recovery semantics affects workflow design and release reliability.

options.title: Support independent producer retries
options.body: Update the intersection input contract to resolve the latest valid artifact from each producer, preserving failed-jobs-only recovery.

options.title: Retry producers as a pair
options.body: Require both shared producer scans to rerun together so the existing attempt-wide artifact names remain valid.

recommendation.title: Support independent producer retries
recommendation.body: Update the intersection input contract to resolve the latest valid artifact from each producer, preserving failed-jobs-only recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the release-gate and retry-capacity changes and is the closest available owner for clarifying the intended workflow contract.
